evidence: Structure verified by tomllib parse of every frozen file plus diffs against the frozen template. (1) task/tests/scoring.toml is byte-identical to the template: [gates] render=0.0 constraints=0.0, [weights] functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2 (sum 1), [floors] functional=0.05; every name has a directory (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual). test.sh, tools/score.py and tools/restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the template (diff empty). (2) All five judge.toml [judge] blocks: judge='claude-code' fallback, mode, timeout, isolated=false, prompt_template='prompt.md'; no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight. Each has the Playwright MCP server with template args. Only scored/functional declares the verifier server: command /usr/local/bin/python3, args ['/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py','$APP_RESTART_HELPER'], matching test.sh:193 'export APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh"', exported before run_suite (test.sh:203-224); test.sh:192 clears the .used marker. (3) Aggregation: gates all_pass, scored weighted_mean. Criteria: render 1 (hro_gate_render) and constraints 1 (hro_gate_shared), both binary weight 1. functional 15 binary, unique ids, weights 4.5,4,3,4,5.5,5,5,2,4,4.5,4,2,5.5,3.5,4.5 = 61.0 (matches the in-file comment '61 in all' and its per-leg breakdown). polish 5 binary, weights sum 9.5. visual 5 likert points=5 weight 1. No empty descriptions, no extra keys, name==id everywhere. (4) Prompts resolve: every prompt.md exists, contains exactly one {criteria} and one {app_context} and no other placeholder; test.sh substitutes {app_context} into /tests/*/*/prompt.md. Every hro_* id cited in prompts/criteria (e.g. hro_intake_restart, hro_unread_seen) exists. restart_app is mentioned only in scored/functional (prompt line 1 and hro_intake_restart). No non-local URL in any prompt/judge.toml/app_context (Lesson 13). Largest assembled prompt: functional batched-equivalent 38,119 B, individual session max 14,412 B, far below 128 KB (Lesson 10). (5) Template deviation: scored/functional/judge.toml sets mode='individual', timeout=600 (template: batched, 9000). harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7 (pinned at tests/Dockerfile 'pip3 install harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7') accepts JudgeMode Literal['batched','individual'] (models.py:142); _arun_agent_individual (judges.py:467-499) runs one agent call per criterion sequentially, each with its own asyncio.wait_for(timeout=judge.timeout), so the comment '15 sessions x 600 s + 900 + 900 = 10800 s < 11100' holds with test.sh '--max-concurrent-agent 1'. The functional prompt's 'One criterion per session' section matches that execution model, and hro_intake_restart (the only restart user) is criterion 1, so it runs first. The file comment records the change as lead-instructed (relayed by the owner, 8 Oct 2026); I cannot independently verify that authorization. RISK (why risk=true): (a) no configured RewardKit/judge run of this frozen candidate exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'), so the new individual-mode functional wiring has never actually loaded/executed in this task; source analysis of the copied 0.1.7 source is not execution. (b) Latent P3: restart_mcp.py:29-32 makes restart_app single-use per run via a file marker; if RewardKit retries hro_intake_restart after a schema-parse failure (judges.py retry loop, _MAX_JUDGE_RETRIES), the retry cannot restart and the criterion prescribes 0 ('if restart_app reports an error or cannot be called, this criterion is 0'). This interaction is shared-template behaviour (also present in batched mode), not a task-introduced structural defect.
counterexample: Broken-app attempt: a static shell or browser-only app cannot pass because both gates are binary all_pass, gate weights 0.0, and score.py/scoring.toml are template-identical with functional floor 0.05; no structural path lets it farm polish/visual. Conforming-app attempt: a correct app could lose hro_intake_restart (4.5/61 of functional) only if the judge's first session output fails schema parsing and RewardKit retries after the single-use restart marker was set (harness-level, latent, unobserved).
